title: IndicJR: A Judge-Free Benchmark of Jailbreak Robustness in South Asian Languages
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark (IndicJR) to evaluate the jailbreak robustness and adversarial safety of large language models across South Asian languages. While it includes safety evaluations for harmful content (e.g., biological or illicit access), it does not contain a specific component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or ethics beyond standard safety alignment and human auditing procedures.
